scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @nue-uno/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-nue-uno --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nue-uno/functions && npm run build -w @nue-uno/web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,database --project demo-nue-uno "vitest run --config rules-tests/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run build
